content.text: {"label":"outage","explanation":"Payments volume jumped to 187 calls at 12:45, against 88.5 forecast (+111%), and service level fell to 16% with 48 abandons. The rise is led by card_declined (2.22x normal), with payment_status_enquiry (1.41x) and fraud_report (1.46x) also up. This lines up with open P1 INC-20261001-6607: the card authorisation gateway is declining debit card transactions online and at POS, with response code 91, and is failing over to DR. Attendance is normal (1 sick vs 2.4 usual) and there is no marketing entry. General is close to forecast, apart from a small new_offer_enquiry rise.","plan_name":"Card gateway outage containment for payments","rationale":"Demand is outage-driven, so the first step is the known-issue IVR message for the rising reasons. This deflects about 20% of those callers at no cost. Payment-status enquiries can be pushed to chat. Capacity comes from free levers first: delayed breaks, a small cross-skill move from general, and cancelled coaching. Overtime then covers the next hours while the DR failover takes effect. The general move is kept small because general has been running around 78–100% and must stay at or above 70%.
